thread.title: Amazon's market cap falls behind Microsoft's into 4th place

title: Amazon's market cap falls behind Microsoft's into 4th place
text:
Published: Mar 29, 2018 12:32 p.m. ET Share Tomi Kilgore Reporter and editor 
Amazon.com Inc. AMZN, -1.20% has lost its hold as the third-most valuable U.S. company by market capitalization, as the recent selloff in the e-commerce giant's stock has knocked it below Microsoft MSFT, +0.94% Amazon's stock fell 1.4% in midday trade, with its market cap falling to $684.3 billion from $693.4 billion, while Microsoft's stock rose 0.6% to lift its market cap to $692.4 billion from $688.3 billion. Amazon's stock has tumbled 9.2% amid a three-session losing streak, weighed by President Trump's criticism of the company. That selloff has shaved $69.3 billion off Amazon's market cap. Over the same time, Microsoft's market cap has lost $29.6 billion. The companies are still behind second-place Alphabet Inc. GOOGL, +2.81% at $717.9 billion and Apple Inc. AAPL, +1.99% at $860.5 billion. Amazon shares have still climbed 21% over the past three months while Microsoft's stock has gained 5.1% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +0.98% has lost 2.6%. Quote References
